answer: The kernel is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the dune. The design leans on bond keyed to a hardware root, re-queued for a second panel, each submission carries a fresh nonce. What survives to the mirror is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work.
